handoff.objective: Perform the final pre-implementation audit of the versioned v2 first-norm semantic protocol.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the pure-squaring repair, exact execution matrix, resource formulas, comparator boundaries, cohort semantics, and executable mutation manifest close every v1 launch blocker.
constraints: Approve only a SANITY_ONLY toy semantic run.
No coefficient matrix, compiler, locator, relation-generation, asymptotic, or ECDLP claim is in scope.
Every mandatory cell and mutation must be executable without post-hoc selection.
A numeric rank agreement cannot replace rank-field provenance.
Any repair requires a preserved version 3 rather than mutation of an approved version.
deliverables: GO, REVISE, or NO-GO verdict with concrete blockers only
completion_gate: All v1 blockers map to explicit v2 fields.
The exact cell and mutation schedules are deterministic and complete.
The resource projection and comparator boundaries are dimensionally correct.
Passing cannot be interpreted as an implemented compiler or ECDLP improvement.
handoff.return_format: Use the repository handoff headings and finish with exactly one next concrete action.
